name: OCRia-nano-1
summary: Turn scanned PDFs into Markdown with tables intact, right on your laptop with no GPU or API key. It installs through the open-source LiteParse tool and is free for personal use and businesses under $2M in revenue and funding.

name: Inkling 2 Mini
summary: Build a web prototype or get help debugging from a screenshot, even offline. Run the model with Ollama on a Mac with at least 32 GB of memory, or try it in the Tinker Playground.

name: GPT-Live-1.1 API
summary: Build a multilingual voice tutor or support assistant that can listen while it speaks. The API costs 5¢ per active minute, with separate charges for any tools or models it calls.

name: Ideogram 4.6
summary: Recolor a product to match your brand or touch up one part of a photo, with output up to 4K. Try it in the app or use the API, where edits start at $0.008.

name: TestSprite 4.0
summary: Describe how your web app should work and get browser tests you can rerun on each code change. Start free and review recordings of failed steps.

name: Genie 4 API
summary: Turn a prompt or reference image into a world you can explore and change as you go, with live sound. Try it in Google AI Studio or build it into your own prototype with the paid Gemini API.

name: Gemini computer use for Mac
summary: Hand off repetitive Mac chores like filling forms, renaming files, or working across apps and sites while you keep using your screen. Gemini runs in a background window, and you approve key steps. Requires a Google AI Plus, Pro, or Ultra plan (US).

name: GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra
summary: Use Sol for everyday coding and Astra for longer projects that span code, documents, and research. Both are in Codex and ChatGPT Work on Plus and Pro, with Sol at one-quarter of Astra's API price per token.
